text:
tanya: Quick pattern proposal after last night's outage: create a lightweight 'postmortem lighthouse' — three parts: 48h quick-closure, 72h watch, and a 2-week RCA slot if recurrence. template below.

ajay: sounds good. want explicit IC rotation rule in there too. if same IC >2 incidents in 30d, force rotate. keeps fresh perspective.

maria: i'll own the 48h quick fixes: breaker + smoke test. can ship to canary in ~2h. include rollback instructions.

lucas: i'll take the 72h watch and run anomaly sweep across 120d. will surface any repeating signatures by EOD tomorrow.

rachel: comms cadence idea: 1) immediate internal pulse (thread), 2) 24h stakeholder digest (one-paragraph), 3) public comm only if SLA/contract exposure.

incident-bot: Task created: INC-5120 - Postmortem Lighthouse (48h/72h/RCA). Owners assigned. https://internal/tasks/INC-5120

ajay: template suggestion (one-line tasks): `task | owner | ETA | effort | verify-step | severity(quick/med/long)`

tanya: adding an IC rotation matrix to the playbook: `if IC_count(user,30d) > 2 -> assign_next_available()`. small automation ticket filed.

maria: PR up with breaker + smoke-check: https://git/repo/patch5120. smoke-check: `curl -sS http://health/db-check | jq -r .status` -> expect "ok".

lucas: alert hist: https://dash/alerts/DB-120d - annotated. will post top-3 suspects.

rachel: also propose a tiny verification ritual for the 24h digest: attach one-line evidence (metric + screenshot) so execs see signal not noise.

tanya: i'll seed the incident doc with the lighthouse template and checklist. reconvene here in 24h; if no recurrence we close quick items and move medium/long tasks to backlog with PM tagging.

ajay: +1. small ops ask: surface the one-line tracker at top of incident doc so people don't have to scroll.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h check-in for INC-5120.
